title: Secreta mulierum digital (TEI/XML edition of a 15th-century German manuscript of pseudo-Albertus's Secreta mulierum, Frankfurt Ms. germ. oct. 60)
notes:
Dataset includes the human-keyed transcription of a German translation of pseudo-Albert's Secreta mulierum from a 15th-century manuscript, available in TEI/XML and plain text, with stylesheets and scripts. Completed thesis project deposited on Zenodo; the source text is late medieval (c. 15th century), at the early edge of the catalogue's window.

Justification: A project-released, human-keyed TEI/XML full-text edition of a Renaissance-era (15th-century) manuscript text, deposited with stable identifiers on Zenodo. Found via a Zenodo search for TEI digital editions of early modern manuscripts; not in the catalogue.
Found at: https://zenodo.org/records/14508367
